registered_by: ACK (protocol drafted by Claude Fable 5.1, frozen on ACK instruction 'carry on with F1')
purpose: Forward shadow comparison of the current (score) contract selector against the value-based shadow selector, and disclosure of scenario values, without changing any production decision.
starts_with_run: the first evening run after commit bb4cf50 (expected run id 20260926_06xxxx, US session 2026-09-25)

frozen_rule.selection_rule_under_test: value_selection_mode=SHADOW, shortlist BEST_SCORE_PER_EXPIRY, eligibility COVERS_PLANNED_HOLD, measure emp_path_r_central; forecast source L3_ON_DISK with age recorded (B1)

population.unit: one (run, ticker, thesis) decision record in a MORNING_VALIDATION run
inclusion: legacy selected contract with a two-sided provider-stamped quote at the morning requote
shadow best contract recorded (contract_value_best_symbol) with contract_value_quality_flag = OK
target_price and invalidation_spot present and non-degenerate (each further than 0.25 x the hold-window vol-budget move from spot)
population.pair_definition: legacy contract vs shadow contract for the same decision record; pairs where the two symbols are identical are recorded but contribute zero difference

to_be_added_to_the_ledger_before_scoring: scenario_values_alg04 (flat, 1sigma, reachable, structural, invalidation; LATE/BASE) with friction_assumption and validation_state=UNVALIDATED
breakeven_p_target (two-outcome lower bound) as review information

outcome_scoring.entry: ask of the contract at the morning requote of the decision run
outcome_scoring.exit: bid of the same contract at the earliest of: underlying TARGET_FIRST session, STOP_FIRST session, exit-policy time stop (Day 20 by the frozen D2 window), last_exit_session (expiry minus exit buffer)
outcome_scoring.if_the_exit_bid_is_not_captured: the pair is UNSCORED and counted; never modelled, never filled from a later snapshot (A3 dependency)
metrics_per_pair: net_return_on_premium (exit_bid - entry_ask) / entry_ask for legacy and shadow
sessions_held, exit_reason, MFE, MAE at bid marks
outcome_scoring.underlying_outcome_recorded_regardless: TARGET_FIRST / STOP_FIRST / TIMEOUT / AMBIGUOUS with first_touch_session (C12)

H1_primary.hypothesis: The shadow selector's contract earns a higher net return on premium than the legacy contract on the same decision.
H1_primary.statistic: median paired difference (shadow - legacy) in net return on premium
H1_primary.interval: 95% block bootstrap by decision session (blocks = sessions), 2000 resamples, seed 20260925
H1_primary.pass: lower bound of the interval > 0 and median difference > 0
H1_primary.minimum_sample: the later of 60 decision sessions and 200 scored pairs, at least 40 of them with different symbols

H2_downside.hypothesis: The shadow contract does not worsen the downside.
H2_downside.statistic: p10 of net return on premium, shadow vs legacy
H2_downside.pass: shadow p10 >= legacy p10 - 0.05 (net return units)

H3_friction.hypothesis: The friction model does not understate realised round-trip cost.
H3_friction.pass: <= 0; failure re-opens friction_model_v1, it does not re-tune it inside this cohort

H4_breakeven_secondary.hypothesis: Rows with breakeven_p_target <= 0.40 realise a higher net return than rows above it (research only; no threshold is tuned inside the cohort).
H4_breakeven_secondary.statistic: difference in median net return on premium between the two groups

H5_stability.hypothesis: retained_share (D3) rises after A1 lands; GEOMETRY_MISSING drops fall to zero.

matched_alternatives: long shares of the same ticker over the same window, entry at the morning open, exit at the same session close as the option (computable from bars now)
sector ETF option of the same direction and horizon (when its quotes are captured; otherwise UNSCORED)
desk-gate list vs harness Tier A list (research only; no authority)

list: asymmetry thresholds x4 (spread 0.15/0.10 x reach 2/3 x p* 0.40)
multiple_testing_disclosure.rule: every further variant is appended here with a date before it is run; none is run on cohort outcomes
multiple_testing_disclosure.deflated_statistics: reported with 15 pre-cohort variants + any appended

governance.no_tuning_on_the_cohort: thresholds, selection rules, friction model and calibration are frozen; a change starts COHORT_2 with its own registration
governance.reporting: weekly summary to ACK; independent human quant review before any authority decision (note 06 s7)
governance.authority_decision: only after H1-H3 pass on the forward cohort AND the historical walk-forward through the production services passes (G4)
governance.this_file: immutable once committed; corrections are appended as a dated amendment block, never edited in place

amendments.reason: F1.b: the Lab extract alias map gains the twelve contract_value_* fields and the ledger candidate event gains selection_pair and prospective_cohort. Book field set and ledger record only; no selection, viability or valuation rule changed, so cohort 1 continues.
